name: Butler
source:
The only man who workes on Harumichi in his estate.
Beside his name, Caliban, he does not talk about himself. But according to Harumichi, he is the most perfect butler with no need in alcohol, smoking, gambling or even wages.
Unbalanced to his short height, he possesses an abnormal strength.
